questions.question: In the Parable of the Great Banquet, what did the invited guests do?
Jesus said that when you give a feast, you should invite whom?
options: Your friends, your family, and your rich neighbors
The priests, the scribes, and the rulers of the people
The strong, the wealthy, and the well-respected
The poor, the maimed, the lame, and the blind
questions.answer: The poor, the maimed, the lame, and the blind
